title: Rust Types
learning_objectives: Recognize common scalar types and how type inference uses surrounding code.
Use tuples and fixed-size arrays to group values.
Access and destructure compound values and choose appropriate numeric types.
explanation: Rust checks types at compile time. Inference can determine many types from how a value is used, while annotations clarify intent or resolve ambiguity. Tuples group values of different types, and arrays group a fixed number of values of the same type.

examples.title: Scalar types and inference
Destructure a tuple
Access a fixed-size array

compiler_error_examples: error[E0277]: the trait bound `i32: From<u32>` is not satisfied
completion_criteria: Exercise tests pass for ordinary and zero-valued inputs
Learner can identify the tuple, array, and scalar types used in the exercise
Learner can explain how an explicit annotation can resolve type ambiguity
